name: Evermore Fist
description: Throw a fist whose force does not fade with distance but keeps on gathering in the arm.

name: Aeon Step
description: Take a long step with no slack in it so the next step begins the instant the foot lands.

name: Unfailing Ward
description: Hold a ward fed so evenly that it does not weaken however long the blows keep falling.

name: Surplus Breath
description: Breathe in more qi than the next effort needs and let the extra bank itself for the one after.

name: Snowballing Palm
description: Roll a palm strike into a follow-up that carries all the force of the first and then adds its own.

name: Escalating Barrage
description: Pour out a barrage in which every blow outweighs the last and the guard breaks by the third.

name: Deepening Press
description: Lean on the opponent's guard with a pressure that grows by a little each breath it is held.

name: Limitless Surge
description: Gather force across several heartbeats and release it as a surge that keeps rising until it meets a target.

name: Runaway Force
description: Let one blow's force loose to feed on itself through the target's body until it spends the strike.

name: Everward
description: Raise a ward that draws on the surrounding qi as it is struck and never runs dry.

name: Ceaseless Parry
description: Parry blow after blow with forearms whose qi renews between each one.

name: Fathomless Guard
description: Hold a guard so deep in qi that no single blow can reach the end of it.

name: Fountainhead Touch
description: Lay both hands on a wound and let a never-failing stream of qi flow into an ally or the self.

name: Constant Stride
description: Hold the same stride through a long retreat without a drop in speed or in balance.

name: Replenishing Aegis
description: Raise an aegis that replaces each point of qi it loses from an inner store the user keeps full.

name: Recovery Loop
description: Cycle qi through a hurt in a closed loop that mends a little more on every pass for an ally or the self.

name: Reflux
description: Take a blow into the guard and pour it back out through the striker at the same measure.

name: Aeon Bulwark
description: Stand fast in a bulwark of qi that renews itself at a rate no assault in reach can outrun.

name: Boundless Renewal
description: Pour an unceasing stream of restoring qi into a gravely hurt ally until wounds close and strength returns.

name: Doubling Fist
description: Throw a punch and let its echo follow in the same path with twice the weight.

name: Loop Pair
description: Pair two steps into a small loop that ends with the user at the opponent's flank.

name: Pairing Ward
description: Raise a ward and then a second ward behind it that stands up the moment the first falls.

name: Pair Echo
description: Turn aside a blow with one forearm and have the other forearm repeat the turn at once.

name: Dual Tally
description: Keep two running counts at once of the opponent's strikes and the user's own to judge who leads.

name: Dual Cascade
description: Cascade strikes from both hands in matched pairs that double in number with each round.

name: Paired Extension
description: Thrust two lines of qi in a matched pair that keep lengthening and cross to bind the target.

name: Redoubling Palm
description: Hit with a palm that redoubles its own force on contact and jars the target's stance.

name: Boundless Pair
description: Cast two linked waves of qi that echo back and forth between the palms and swell with each pass.

name: Infinite Mirror
description: Face mirrored wards at each other so a blow caught between them bounces on and on until spent.

name: Soar Step
description: Push off the ground on a rising step that carries the body high before it falls.

name: Raptor Thread
description: Send a thin line of qi after a moving target that keeps tracking as it travels.

name: Talon Reach
description: Hook two fingers forward on a lengthening line of qi that seeks the target's throat.

name: Ascending Pace
description: Run up a slope of qi laid out step by step and never let the pace fall.

name: Raptor Gleam
description: Cast attention outward like a hawk's eye and mark every living thing it can reach.

name: Keen Wing Guard
description: Beat both arms in wide arcs that turn blows aside faster than they can be repeated.

name: Unending Stoop
description: Dive onto the target and rise at once into the next dive without touching down.

name: Tracking Thread
description: Fix a line of qi on a fleeing target that plays out as far as it runs and tugs it back.

name: Azure Pursuit
description: Chase a target in an unbroken run and strike at every pass without losing speed.

name: Endless Dive
description: Fall onto the target in a dive whose speed keeps rising until the blow lands with crushing weight.

name: Floorless Sky
description: Tread upward on steps of qi that never end and strike down at opponents who cannot follow.

name: Vow Unbroken
description: Hold a guard under a vow never to break and let the vow feed the ward as it is spent.

name: Lasting Bearing
description: Step along a bearing kept true over any distance with no drift off the line.

name: Sworn Blow
description: Strike under oath so the blow lands with a weight that grows each time the vow is renewed.

name: Vow Reach
description: Cast a line of qi along a bearing sworn to the target that follows it to any distance.

name: Sworn Extension
description: Extend a thrust along a sworn bearing that lengthens until it finds the mark.

name: Oathbound Cord
description: Pay out a cord of qi sworn to the target that lengthens with every step they take away.

name: Vow Accrual
description: Add a small sworn increment of power to the user or an ally with each kept promise in the fight.

name: Vow Unspent
description: Unleash a blow that carries every unspent vow of the fight in one bearing onto a single target.

name: Endless Oath
description: Swear a lasting oath into the target's qi that shuts it in a closing circle for as long as it is held.

name: Unceasing Gust
description: Throw a palm in a gust that is renewed by the next breath the instant it fades.

name: Gale Run
description: Run in a gale of one's own making that sustains the pace with no loss in the legs.

name: Draught Shield
description: Hold a shield of whirling draught that is refilled as it is torn.

name: Far Gust
description: Fling a gust of qi across a great gap without any loss of bite.

name: Windcount Reading
description: Feel the shifts of air around the user and count each body that moves through them.

name: Rising Gale
description: Cast a rising wind that adds its weight to every blow thrown inside it and rattles the guard.

name: Gale Chain
description: Chain a target in lengthening loops of wind that tighten the more they struggle.

name: Gust Accrual
description: Gather speed from each passing gust and lend it to the user or an ally.

name: Gale Everlasting
description: Raise a gale that does not subside while the user stands and widens the longer it blows.

name: Restless Gale
description: Ride a wind that never rests to strike and pass and strike again with rising speed.
